Subject: Adult woman holding a folded handwritten letter, calm expression, sculptural wool coat with asymmetrical volume and raw-edged layers.
Environment: Quiet snowy train platform at dusk, clean background, soft distance lights, station markings reduced to abstract shapes.
Lighting: Pale blue-gray overcast light, soft breath in cold air, gentle rim light from the station lamps.
Material: Thick wool texture, paper letter, fine organic film grain, muted winter color palette.
Composition: Medium portrait shot, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, subject slightly off-center.
Style: Restrained winter cinema mood, natural photographic realism, quiet still-frame atmosphere.
Context/Tone: Romantic melancholy, private narrative, restrained emotion.
Output Constraints: Aspect ratio 16:9; background stays clean; paper marks stay decorative and abstract.
